topic: Autonomous research agents: experimental automation and trustworthy results
audience: Student researchers with basic programming knowledge
central_question: Which research tasks can we delegate to agents, and what evidence makes their results trustworthy?
voice: Clear, skeptical, practical; distinguish observed results from vendor claims
scope: Computational experiments, evaluation, reproducibility; physical labs as a contrasting case
exclusions: Generic AI news, investment advice, unsupported AGI predictions
reader_return_reason: Track new methods and failures that change how students should run experiments
